author: Clijmart
body:
Hey,
after a while, I decided to work on some more Avicus Maps and this is the first one :)

Map Info:
Medium sized map with iron in small houses behind spawn, 4 monuments in total.
Players have the ability to enchant in their spawnpoint.
2 chests on each side with S-wheat (See what I did there?) items.
Map is shaped in multiple reindeer shapes :D

Links:
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/ggUl3
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/at3gvcnkcq27c4t/Reindeers_%5BDTM%5D.rar
XML: Being worked on!

Please leave your feedback down below <3

- Clijmart
